request: If edge with bigger radius is considered as top, add supporting structure to the bottom of the frame by offseting inner wall by 2cm with thickness of 0,5cm of the supporting structure all around. This will create step at the bottom of the frame, enlarging bottom surface area. Leave out radii at the bottom edges. Add radii from top, 0,2cm which will create smoothe transition from above. Bottom remains flat.

actions.operation: Create a supporting structure forming a step at the bottom of the frame by offsetting the inner wall.

parameters.offset_direction: Inward from the existing inner-wall loop toward the central aperture, creating an additional continuous annular bearing shelf while preserving the external envelope.
parameters.extrusion_direction: Normal to the rear seating land and away from the existing frame.
parameters.boolean_condition: Additive union with the original frame

actions.target: The inner wall at the bottom of the frame.
actions.relational_constraint: Apply the supporting structure all around the frame. Determine the bottom using the edge with the bigger existing radius as the top reference. The larger-radius external edge is the radius-10 convex outer spine in S03, with radius-53 corner patches; therefore the opposite rear seating side S04 is localized as the bottom. Use the complete S01 inner-wall loop as the profile reference and attach the new support continuously to the S04 rear side.
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved: the bigger-radius top reference is the S03 convex outer spine. The bottom is the opposing S04 rear seating side. The inner wall is the complete S01 rounded-rectangular aperture loop. Offset the projected loop toward the aperture center so that the new support enlarges the available bottom bearing area without increasing the outer perimeter.
steps: Establish the part orientation from the asymmetric through-thickness section. Treat the broad radius-10 convex spine surfaces 0033, 0035, 0037 and 0039, together with the radius-53 corner surfaces 0034, 0036, 0038 and 0040, as the larger-radius top reference. Treat the opposing planar rear annular seating land 0041 in S04 as the bottom-side datum.
Create a sketch on the plane coincident with the planar rear annular seating land, face code 0041 and Brep_id FACE 34. Orient the sketch normal away from the existing solid on the bottom side.

Project or convert the complete bottom-side boundary of the S01 inner aperture interface into the sketch. The projected loop must include straight walls 0000, 0002, 0004 and 0006 and rounded corner walls 0001, 0003, 0005 and 0007 so the support remains continuous through all four corners.

Use the intersection of the S01 inner walls with the S04 bottom datum as the original rounded-rectangular boundary. Maintain associativity to the source inner-wall geometry rather than redrawing an unrelated rectangle.

Offset the projected inner-wall loop by 20 mm toward the central aperture. The offset must be an in-plane geometric offset, with straight spans remaining parallel and corner arcs remaining tangent to their adjacent spans.

Use the original projected inner-wall loop and the new 20 mm inward-offset loop as the two closed boundaries of an annular sketch region. This produces a continuous support ring that extends the bottom bearing region toward the aperture while leaving a reduced but open central clearance.

Check that the 20 mm offset does not self-intersect at the rounded corners. If the CAD kernel reports an offset failure, construct the inner offset loop with four parallel straight segments and tangent corner arcs whose radii equal the corresponding projected aperture radii minus 20 mm.

Extrude the annular region 5 mm normal to face 0041, away from the existing frame and toward the localized bottom direction. Use an additive or fused extrusion so the support becomes one solid with the original frame.

Define the added material as new section S05, a continuous rounded-rectangular bottom supporting step. Its upper boundary is attached to S01 and S04, its underside is a new planar annular face, and its inner and outer vertical boundaries follow the rounded-rectangular profile.

Do not modify or remove the S03 outer protective spine, the S02 broad front seating flange, or the original S01 locating-wall surfaces above the new step. Preserve the original external envelope and the principal mating-wall geometry except at the local fused attachment.
Recompute the solid and verify that the support is continuous around all four straight spans and four corners, that no disconnected corner bodies remain, and that the central aperture remains open.

actions.operation: Exclude radii from the bottom edges of the supporting structure.

parameters.required_edge_condition: Sharp intersection between the planar underside and the support sidewalls

actions.target: The bottom edges created or affected by the supporting structure.
actions.relational_constraint: The bottom edges must remain unrounded. This applies to every edge bounding the new planar underside of S05, including all straight spans and rounded-rectangle corner segments.
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved after Action 1: the bottom edges are the generated inner and outer perimeter edge loops at the lower termination of the 5 mm support extrusion. These generated edges do not have original model.json face_code labels.
steps: After completing the 5 mm additive extrusion, identify the new planar underside face by selecting the generated planar face farthest from the original rear seating land 0041 along the extrusion direction.
Identify both closed edge loops bounding that underside: the loop adjoining the support's inner sidewall and the loop adjoining its outer or attachment-side wall.
Exclude every edge in these lower loops from all subsequent fillet and chamfer features. Do not apply the existing 2 mm rear transition treatment from S04 to the new lower edges.

If the CAD system automatically propagates a fillet around tangent edges, disable tangent-chain propagation for the lower loops or explicitly remove the generated lower edges from the fillet selection set.
Maintain a geometrically sharp, constant-height intersection between the support sidewalls and underside so the full planar bearing footprint is retained.
Verify in section views through a straight span and through a corner that the lower edge profile has no radius, bevel, draft-induced rounding, or blend surface.

actions.operation: Add radii to the top edges of the supporting structure.

parameters.application_scope: Exposed upper perimeter edges of the new support only

actions.target: The top edges of the added supporting structure.
actions.relational_constraint: Apply the radii from the top to produce a smooth transition when viewed or approached from above. Apply a continuous 2 mm blend around the complete rounded-rectangular upper edge loop while excluding all bottom edges.
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved after Action 1: select the generated upper exposed edge loop of S05 at or adjacent to the original S04 rear datum. These generated edges have no original model.json face_code. Face 0041 is the original parent face used to distinguish the upper loop from the flat lower loop.
steps: Identify the exposed upper edge loop created where the top of the new S05 support transitions into the aperture-side geometry at the S04 rear datum.
Select all tangent-connected straight and curved segments of that upper rounded-rectangular loop. Confirm that the selection propagates through four straight spans and four corner transitions.
Apply a constant-radius fillet of 2 mm to the selected upper edge loop.

Constrain the fillet to the upper edge only. Do not include either lower perimeter loop of the support and do not replace the original rear fillets 0042 through 0049 unless a local top blend must merge tangentially with them.
Where the upper support edge intersects an existing S01 or S04 transition, use tangent or rolling-ball propagation so the 2 mm blend remains continuous and does not create sliver faces.
Confirm that the 2 mm radius is smaller than the 5 mm support thickness and therefore leaves a planar portion on the underside and adequate vertical wall below the blend.
Inspect straight-span and corner sections to verify a smooth transition from above, with no discontinuity at the junctions between cylindrical straight-span fillets and toroidal corner portions.

parameters.flatness_condition: No fillet, chamfer, crown, draft, pocket, boss, or offset variation on the generated underside

actions.target: The bottom surface of the modified frame and supporting structure.
actions.relational_constraint: The bottom must remain planar and must not receive bottom-edge radii that alter its flat condition. The final lowest surface of S05 must be parallel to the original rear seating land 0041 and uniformly offset from it by 5 mm.
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved after Action 1: the final bottom surface is the new planar annular termination face of the S05 extrusion. It is generated from face 0041 and therefore has no original model.json face_code.
steps: Use original planar rear seating face 0041, Brep_id FACE 34, as the reference datum for the new support thickness and underside orientation.
Terminate the S05 extrusion with a blind distance of exactly 5 mm rather than an up-to-surface condition that could produce variable thickness.
Require the generated underside to be parallel to face 0041 and normal to the extrusion direction.
Do not apply any face fillet, dome, draft, shell offset, or surface deformation to the generated underside.
Keep all lower boundary edges sharp as specified in the preceding action so the planar contact area extends fully to the support boundaries.
Measure the distance from multiple points on the generated underside to face 0041 and verify a constant 5 mm separation.
Run a planarity check on the final underside and confirm that it is one coplanar annular bearing surface, or multiple coplanar faces only if the CAD kernel splits the face at tangent corner seams.
Perform a final interference and clearance review to ensure the inward 20 mm support does not close the central aperture and that the modified part remains a single watertight solid.

intention: Provide supporting structure at the bottom of the frame.
Enlarge the bottom surface area by creating a step.
Create a smooth transition from above while keeping the bottom flat.
